flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, utilities/emailutility/EmailService, application-*.properties and cron-schedules-*.properties; furnish_processing/FurnishApprovalHelper (source of the hirer contact). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not used; utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil
note: Status in stories.json: 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: 'Vault & SMS Code Split. May need to check if SMS permission needs to be granted to the api App Service server' (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. An individual hirer (idType not B) gets the RD1 SMS through the same eNotification job as the owner (OCMS12.4): combined per recipient + stage + due date, sent as a batch SMS through SmsUtil. Findings: (1) application-prod.properties has sms.enable=false and no sms.allowedSources, so SmsUtil refuses to send in prod; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments; (3) the SMS text (template RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL) is in the database, not in the repo, and the template name does not distinguish owner and hirer; (4) the latest mobile number from DataHive is switched off by a flag (see OCMS12.22); (5) the combining step is Sebagian because the combined key contains stage and due date, same as OCMS12.19. Note for the parent: OCMS12.4 rates the same combining step Sesuai; the fits should be aligned. Tickets: none changes the verdict (OCMS-DF-2026-180 is for ENA only). SMS permission and Vault: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. Combining notices per hirer and the batch SMS sending exist in the code, but SMS is switched off in prod (sms.enable=false), the cron is inactive, and the template text is not visible in the repo. Ask for evidence of template RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL and confirmation of the prod config.

steps.step: The mobile number of the individual hirer is obtained from DOS (DataHive)
steps.detail: refreshIndividualContactInfo reads the Singpass contact from DataHive (CONTACT at least 8 characters, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2745) and patches offenderTelNo into owner_driver (2800-2820), but refreshContactInfo and batchPreloadContactInfo return immediately unless cron.enareminder.datahive is 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2329, 2468) and the value is false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So the contact already stored in owner_driver is used; for a hirer who came in through furnish that is the contact from the furnish application (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:556-558). Same fit as OCMS12.22 step 2 and OCMS12.4 step 1 (same fact). DOS = DataHive cannot be confirmed from repo; the DataHive/Vault connection cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Unique individual hirers are identified and their outstanding notices are combined into one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191) groups through getRecipientKey: the individual key is 'I_' + ID number, the company key is 'B_' + UEN (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2230-2245), but the combined key = recipient + stage + paymentDueDate (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2178). The same hirer with notices of a different due date or stage becomes separate groups and can receive more than one message on the same day, while the story asks for one unique recipient per batch. Same fit as OCMS12.19 and OCMS12.20 (same fact). Hirers in the exclusion list and passport hirers are removed before the SMS is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-243).

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 1st letter reminder
steps.detail: generateMessages picks template RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or RD1_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED from the stage (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:274-307, 443-476) and prepareTemplateData supplies noticeCount, combinedNotices, amountPayable, paymentDueDate, vehicleNo (410-433). No code inserts a reference to the letter (number or date of the 1st letter); whether the text mentions the first letter and lists the notices depends only on the template in ocms_template_store, which is not in the repo (cannot verify from repo). A missing template means the SMS is skipped (1563-1567). The template is chosen by the name <stage>_<channel>_<recipient type> (determineTemplateName) with no owner/hirer/driver role dimension, so an owner and a hirer at the same stage use the same template; whether the wording suits a hirer cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The SMS is sent in one batch job and the result is recorded
steps.detail: sendBatchSms splits the records into batches of at most 1000 and calls smsUtil.sendBatchSmsSimple with source ENOTIFICATION (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1591-1612); saveSendStatus records into ocms_sms_notification_records (601-640). The job flag notification.sms.enabled=true (application.properties:176). But SmsUtil refuses to send when sms.enable=false and the source is not in sms.allowedSources (SmsUtil.java:401-409, called from 601): prod has sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) with no sms.allowedSources, so the result is status 'disabled' and the batch is marked failed; uat and dev allow ENOTIFICATION (application-uat.properties:80-82). The daily cron is also enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; NotificationJobsScheduler.java:42-55). The real server property values and the Postman2 permission from the App Service cannot verify from repo.
